posts.title: Inside Dawanau: How Kano's Sesame Farmers Are Scaling for Export
posts.excerpt: A look at how cooperative cleaning and grading centers are helping small sesame farms meet 99.5% purity export standards.
posts.content:
Dawanau Market in Kano has long been West Africa's largest grain market, but a quiet transformation is underway among its sesame seed farmers. By pooling resources into shared cleaning and grading equipment, smallholder cooperatives are now able to meet the strict 99.5% purity threshold demanded by export buyers in Asia and Europe.

Farmers say the shift has doubled their per-ton earnings compared to selling ungraded seed locally. NaijaAgroConnect is working with three cooperatives in the region to list export-ready batches directly on the marketplace, cutting out layers of middlemen.

posts.title: Cold-Chain Innovation: Solar-Powered Cooling for Catfish Farmers
posts.excerpt: Off-grid solar cold rooms are helping South-East fish farmers cut post-harvest losses by up to 40%.
posts.content:
Post-harvest spoilage has historically eaten into the margins of catfish farmers across Anambra and Enugu states. A new wave of solar-powered cold rooms, funded through farmer cooperatives and micro-loans, is changing that picture.

Early adopters report spoilage rates dropping from roughly 30% to under 10%, allowing them to hold stock longer and negotiate better prices with wholesale buyers instead of selling in a rush at harvest time.

posts.title: Farmer Spotlight: Idanre's Cocoa Estates Go Fully Traceable
posts.excerpt: Chief Mrs. Folake Adebayo's cocoa estate is piloting batch-level traceability from farm gate to export container.
posts.content:
As European buyers tighten deforestation and traceability requirements under new import regulations, AgroGold Cocoa & Cashew Estates in Idanre, Ondo State, has begun tagging every cocoa batch with GPS-linked harvest records.

The pilot, developed with local agritech partners, lets buyers scan a QR code on each bag to see the originating farm plot, harvest date, and fermentation records — a feature increasingly demanded by export-grade cocoa buyers.
